gaps.explanation: p8 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints four enterprise fund columns (Electric, Water, Sewer, Sanitation) with no schedule of their own; detail[] has no business-type lines. JSON receipts = total operating revenues 2,088,408 + interest income 7,171 + grant income 27,793 = 2,123,372. Per column: Electric 1,302,503 + 159,228 + 11,922 + 3,251 + 11,250 = 1,488,154; Water 237,493 + 37,751 + 3,156 + 1,350 + 10,293 = 290,043; Sewer 117,376 + 26,495 + 1,300 = 145,171; Sanitation 181,296 + 11,188 + 1,270 + 6,250 = 200,004. Sum 2,123,372 = statement 2,123,372. Internal Service Fund column (27,920 interdepartmental charges, 84 interest) excluded.
